title: Option bounds and the decision to exercise
objectives: Derive European option bounds by dated portfolio dominance
Build the prepaid-share replication for a deterministic proportional dividend yield
Prove the nondividend American-call result with its rate condition
Calculate early-exercise decisions from continuation values and derive American parity inequalities
prerequisites: European put–call parity and funded option payoffs from chapter 13; discount factors and replication from chapters 02 and 08.
source_scope: Complete English captions for positions 32–33 read sequentially. Weak bounds, rate and dividend assumptions, and model-based continuation values are made explicit. The finite exercise tree is an original pedagogical construction, developed further in chapter 18.
